source.rule: MONIT=Y stores item PM counters per individual; MONIT=N converts item-linked PM to system PM. Monitored items require MaterielStructure and must not use traditional ItemStructure/FRT CM. Item PM requires a scheduled PMReplacement removal and local PMLocation for both system work and removed item overhaul.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Both frozen arms import/export exactly and calculate with zero conversion errors and nonempty reports.
Each arm has one installed item, one spare at zero initial age, no failure mode, no FRT branch, and an item-linked OPHOURS=2 PM.
The MONIT flag is the only behavioral input difference; descriptive PDESC is the only other arm difference.

After the first two-hour mission, event and report evidence must identify the PM trigger, physical removal, spare issue, item overhaul, task timing, inventory path, and terminal item/system state for each arm.
A separately written read-only replay must reconcile event log, item/stock and system reports, source hashes, and native closure.
limits: This variant isolates MONIT=Y/N on a zero-prelife item with scheduled removal; it can establish identity retention only to the extent exposed by native item events and subsequent use.

An earlier frozen v1.0.0 candidate omitted PMReplacement. Its native run produced warning #243 (incomplete PM at end support station), left the aircraft unavailable after hour 10, and is excluded from acceptance.
Different initial ages, position-linked PM, nested replacement, and multiple counters remain other variants.
GUI content and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
